answer: A farm therefore pays the burn once for each extra identity on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. The atlas debit happens at intake, prism totals the burned amount, and falcon anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 30 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. That is 33 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
